Reading

Fair trade

Fair trade is an international movement that tries to provide fair prices and working conditions for workers and small companies in developing countries. In order for a company to be fair trade, customers pay a price for products which is above the usual market price. This is to make sure workers who produce the products get a fair payment. They must also have safe working conditions and can help to make important decisions.

There are more than a thousand companies included in the movement and they produce many products including fruit, vegetables, drinks, art, and furniture. These products come from areas including South America, Africa, and Asia.

There is also a company called The Fair Trade Furniture Company, which sells things like sofas and armchairs which are made in Java, Indonesia, based on the fair trade model. The furniture is designed in Sweden, then the designs are sent to Java where workers receive fair payment to make them in safe conditions. The company then sells the furniture in the U.K.
